_doc: Songs a dish can play (src/songs.py). Brandon writes songs as A Man Before a King; a song here is one of his, and its words are from his lyrics. Cooking the dish that names a song (its recipe's 'song') stops the soundtrack and plays the song once; its power lasts exactly as long as the song plays, timed in real seconds (seconds), then the soundtrack comes back. 'damage_taken' multiplies every blow and spell on the hero while it plays (Player.take_damage; starvation is not a blow). 'label' is the effect's name on the sidebar and the character sheet. 'lines': 'start' after the dish is eaten, 'end' when the song is over.

start: Caviar and tater tots: high and low on different plates, sitting at the same table tonight.
While the song plays, every blow and spell on you does half damage.
end: The song ends. Nobody saw this coming, but somehow everything's right.
Blows land at their full weight again.
